f4b4bb981e:163b065d3b29a229.title: Vexto - Incident Response Desktop App UI UX
f4b4bb981e:163b065d3b29a229.summary: Vexto is a desktop app that gives our dispatch team real-time visibility into every vehicle in the fleet. It brings live GPS tracking, accident detection, and webcam verification into one system, so we can confirm incidents faster, respond with full context, and keep the whole operation under control. The project moved from fleet data audit to system architecture, incident logic, and map-based UX flows. Time was spent aligning live GPS, accident detection, and webcam feeds into one platform. The deepest work was structuring real-time logic that stays reliable at scale. We prioritized map-first navigation over list-based menus, since dispatchers think in location, not records. Analysis showed incident context mattered more than raw data, so we surfaced vehicle status, connectivity, and live webcam access in one card ? cutting verification time and improving response control.

f4b4bb981e:45ba4d56110252b6.title: Global Digital Collaboration Conference
f4b4bb981e:45ba4d56110252b6.summary: Visual identity for the Global Digital Collaboration Conference 2026 in Geneva. GDC brings together governments, international organisations, technology companies and other stakeholders to collaborate on the digital infrastructure and standards that increasingly connect our world. At the heart of the identity is the Global Barcode, an idea conceived by GDC founder Daniel Goldscheider. It translates the flags of all UN member states into simple vertical colour codes, based on the colours and their proportions within each national flag. Put together, they form one global code. And one very, very long flag. This became the starting point for the visual identity: an endless flag that folds, bends and winds its way through posters, spaces, shirts, lanyards and the conference itself. For the participant badges, the principle became personal: each name generates its own individual colour code.

f4b4bb981e:eaf91ce84cda68fb.title: Bradesco - São João
f4b4bb981e:eaf91ce84cda68fb.summary: We were invited by Lovely to create this São João campaign for Bradesco, inspired by the friendly rivalry between Caruaru and Campina Grande, home to two of Brazil's biggest June festivals. Building on the campaign concept, we developed a visual language inspired by Northeastern Brazilian folk culture and the tradition of repente, a form of improvised poetic dueling built around rhymes, wit, and playful provocation. We created a series of handcrafted illustrations that bring these two cities together, exploring the colors, shapes, and visual elements associated with São João celebrations. Each composition was designed to capture the spirit of rivalry while also celebrating a sense of unity. The result is a series of pieces that turn rivalry into connection and visually express the campaign's central message: the greatest São João is the one we create together.

f4b4bb981e:ec58b8cd447803b8.title: FoundersCard
f4b4bb981e:ec58b8cd447803b8.summary: FoundersCard has built a unique proposition around access?connecting an ambitious community of entrepreneurs and business leaders with exceptional benefits, experiences, and opportunities. Our challenge was to create a digital experience that felt as considered and valuable as the membership itself. We began by rethinking the experience from the ground up. Stripping away complexity, sharpening the hierarchy, and creating a clearer way to communicate the breadth of the FoundersCard world. The goal was simple: make something premium without feeling exclusive for the sake of it, and sophisticated without becoming complicated. A new visual language brought that thinking to life. Bold typography, confident layouts, elevated imagery, and a more editorial approach gave the brand greater presence and personality. A flexible design system created consistency across the experience while leaving room for partners, benefits, destinations, and stories to each have their own moment.

a4977d3fa4:4bf8cd4bb2c56b6f.summary: Summary Bradley Cooper will star as field commander Duke in a new live-action 'G.I. Joe' reboot from Paramount PicturesThe film is directed by Danny McBride, who co-wrote the script alongside Jeff Fradley and John CarcieriParamount has officially uncoupled the 'G.I. Joe' franchise from its previously teased Transformers crossover Paramount Pictures has officially cast Bradley Cooper as field commander Duke in its upcoming G.I. Joe film reboot. The project is set to be directed by Danny McBride, who also co-wrote the screenplay alongside Jeff Fradley and John Carcieri to deliver a fresh take on the iconic Hasbro toy line.While specific plot details and additional casting remain under wraps, the upcoming feature marks McBride’s first major action tentpole as a director following his work on HBO series such as The Righteous Gemstones and Vice Principals. Paramount confirmed that this new standalone iteration has been officially "uncoupled" from the Transformers universe, setting aside the crossover concept previously teased at the end of 2023's Transformers: Rise of the Beasts.Produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura, Mark Vahradian, and Zev Foreman for Hasbro Entertainment, the project adds to a major slate of IP revivals at Paramount. Cooper, a 12-time Oscar nominee, takes on the iconic leadership role while currently in production on an Ocean's 11 prequel that he is directing and starring in alongside Margot Robbie and Monica Barbaro.Release date and production details for Paramount's G.I. Joe reboot are expected to be announced in the coming months. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

The textile is a high-tenacity nylon prized for abrasion resistance and long used in military gear, packs and workwear, and here it is mapped onto essentially the same layout the Vomero 5 uses in its warm-weather versions. At the end of 2024, Nike introduced the Vomero 5 Roam, a spin-off that went all in on weatherproofing with nylon base layers, rubber foxing that wraps around the shoe and beefed-up traction. That approach reshaped the look of the model considerably. This new build lands between the two, adding protection through material choice alone while leaving the silhouette's design language untouched.It's a logical move for a shoe that has become one of the defining faces of Nike's mesh runner wave. Originally a late-2000s performance running model, the Vomero 5 was revived as a lifestyle staple and grew into one of the Swoosh's most recognizable silhouettes. a4977d3fa4:6fb1d0ced2f109e8.title: Raymond Weil Expands Its Anniversary Story With the Limited-Edition Millesime Jubilee Watch
a4977d3fa4:6fb1d0ced2f109e8.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:6fb1d0ced2f109e8.summary: Summary Raymond Weil marks its 50th anniversary with the millesime Jubilee chronograph.The 39mm steel watch features a light-blue bi-compax dial and RW5030 movement.Limited to 500 pieces, it is priced at $4,275 USD. Raymond Weil is continuing its 50th-anniversary celebrations with the new Millesime Jubilee, a limited-edition automatic chronograph that follows the ultra-exclusive The Fifty unveiled at Watches & Wonders earlier this year. Founded in Geneva in 1976, the independent, family-owned watchmaker has been revisiting its history throughout 2026 via its travelling Legacy Tour, and Jubilee translates the anniversary story into a more widely available proposition. Where The Fifty was restricted to 50 examples powered by restored, hand-decorated Valjoux 23-6 movements dating from 1976, Jubilee is limited to 500 pieces, carrying forward its predecessor’s neo-vintage design language within the contemporary millesime collection.The watch is housed in a 39mm stainless steel case measuring 12.9mm thick, with a sapphire glassbox crystal accentuating the layered construction of its light-blue dial. Two midnight-blue, azurage-finished subdials establish the bi-compax chronograph layout, complemented by a silver-toned chapter ring, textured central section and an applied “EST 1976” cartouche referencing the Maison’s founding year. Black hour markers and obelisk-shaped hour and minute hands feature green-glowing Super-LumiNova, while a midnight-blue calfskin strap completes the restrained color palette. Inside is the self-winding RW5030 chronograph calibre, delivering a 62-hour power reserve and visible through a sapphire caseback; the watch is also water-resistant to 50 meters.The millesime Jubilee was officially unveiled in Sydney, the seventh stop of Raymond Weil’s 2026 Legacy Tour, which will subsequently travel to Singapore and Paris as the brand’s anniversary program approaches its conclusion. The timepiece is limited to 500 individually numbered examples and…

a4977d3fa4:b26d57ba4b6074e4.title: ISSEY MIYAKE SS27 Is a Breath of Fresh Air
a4977d3fa4:b26d57ba4b6074e4.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:b26d57ba4b6074e4.summary: Summary Issey Miyake's Spring/Summer 2027 collection, "Figure of Ma," interprets the Japanese idea of meaningful negative space as the air between fabric and body.Ballooning trench coats, plaster-inspired tops, mesh knit capris, signature pleated pieces and a Camper footwear collaboration all shift shape with the wearer, moving with the body rather than confining it. Built around “Ma”, the Japanese aesthetic concept of meaningful negative space between elements, Issey Miyake’s Spring/Summer 2027 collection interprets “Ma” as the air and space between fabric and the body. Satoshi Kondo, the Japanese house’s head designer and art director since 2019, debuted the latest collection, “Figure of Ma”, with an all-black set at the Judo Institute during Paris Fashion Week. The show opened in silence, with a single dancer draped in beige pleats, then a troupe introduced a giant cloud-like billowing fabric that unveiled a collection of sculptural yet featherlight tops, voluminous ultra-light outerwear that catches the wind, and vibrant signature pleats.The collection introduced rounded silhouettes, airy volumes, and surfaces that morphed with the wearer’s every movement. Each piece captured air and shifted shape with the wearer's movement — ballooning trench coats in purple and black, torso-molded plaster gauze-inspired sleeveless tops, textured mesh knit capris, a puffed-shoulder plisse skirt, and patterned pleated outerwear. Also revealed were buttery leather bags, floppy pleated headwear, and a footwear collaboration with Camper. Issey Miyake's “Figure of Ma” collection moves with the body rather than confining it. Sleeves and hems moved as the models did, billowing and deflating like breathing, taking a new form as fabric met the body, turning tailored silhouettes into dynamic expressions of “Ma”. a4977d3fa4:3612ea737213e327.title: Salman Toor Paints the Highs and Lows of Queer Nightlife at London’s Courtauld Gallery
a4977d3fa4:3612ea737213e327.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:3612ea737213e327.summary: Summary New York-based Pakistani-American artist unveils his first European solo at Courtauld Gallery in London, open until January 10, 2027The exhibition comprises 19 paintings focused on human connection and belonging, seen through his queer, brown protagonists Making his European debut, Pakistani-American painter Salman Toor lands in London for Someone Like You, his new solo exhibition at the Courtauld Gallery. Featuring 19 of his most iconic works, the presentation gives Britain a deservedly momentous introduction to Toor, who the New York Times dubbed “one of the most fascinating painters of his generation.”For the past decade, the New York-based artist has been redrawing narratives around immigration, desire, and power, placing queer brown men at the center of their own stories. Though the characters are fictional, Toor roots them in his own memories, imbuing them with a diaristic intimacy.But the works are more than odes to queer joy. They “inhabit the tension between intimacy and exposure, belonging and estrangement,” he said. “What it means to find a community, but also the daily costs associated with visibility”. Just as quickly as we succumb to the buzz of Toor’s sumptuously painted club scenes, so lively you can almost hear it, we retreat, with his protagonists, into quieter vignettes of alienation and estrangement. Toor manages a mastery of both the thrills of a night out and its aftermath, awake in the loneliest hours of the night.Zeroing in on human connection through hazy figures, distinctly their own while bleeding into one another. More than they are glamorous, they’re real, caught between the desire to belong while still trying to understand how to feel at home. Across the board, LOEWE introduced a highly wearable lineup characterized by slick materials, a bold summer color palette, and subtle yet interesting logo placements. Rather than ornamentation, the textiles and colors are what made these looks stand out. Minty green, yellow, blue, and red-orange dominated the overall color spectrum of the collection, while summer stripes and florals brought occasional texture. On several looks, where one would expect a leather or corduroy collar, there’s instead a metallic collar with exuberant gradients of orange and blue, matching wrap-style sunglasses styled throughout the show. Other outerwear styles continued to the sport-oriented aesthetic of the previous collections, as seen in a number of shell jackets, utility coats, and anoraks. Notably, small LOEWE tags were sewn onto the flies of pants, offered in turquoise, gray, red, and olive. Discreet LOEWE logos also appeared on the toe box of new scuba-style moccasins, offered in a selection of colors like tan, black, pink, and yellow. The aquatic theme continues in a range of branded leather caps resembling swimming caps.Joining the logo trousers were some more unconventional pant styles featuring blooming flies, flaring out above the waist. a4977d3fa4:e8a7e3c6ee416a40.title: Streetsnaps: How Gia Seo Turns the Everyday Target Bag Into Her Main Character Accessory
a4977d3fa4:e8a7e3c6ee416a40.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:e8a7e3c6ee416a40.summary: In the landscape of modern styling, few creatives command color, texture, and unexpected proportion quite like Gia Seo. As a creative director, wardrobe stylist, and resident maximalist in New York City, Seo has built a reputation for turning outfit assembly into an art form. Known for her expressive, narrative-first aesthetic, she treats personal style as a continuous conversation between high-end design and everyday utility.Stepping onto the streets of Manhattan, Seo effortlessly integrates Target’s iconic bullseye reusable bag into two distinct, everyday looks. In her first outfit, she leans into classic city tailoring with a twist, pairing a KBB by KAHLANA belted trench coat with a pleated, mixed-pattern plaid midi skirt and sharp black leather boots. Rather than treating the vibrant red-and-white bag as an afterthought, she wears it slung over her shoulder as a graphic anchor that breaks up traditional autumnal tones.For her second look, Seo pivots to a more relaxed, downtown energy. She styles the KBB by KAHLANA low-rise jeans alongside an embroidered cream button-up detailed with black rosettes, accessorizing with studded platform clogs, slim sunglasses, and a green pepper keychain hooked to her belt loop. Here, the red bag acts as a bold pop of color against neutral denim, proving how easily a hyper-functional bag can double as a deliberate statement piece when layered into a well-curated fit.For Seo, a bag’s true value lies in how seamlessly it moves through the chaos of a full city day. Whether she’s carrying fabric swatches between studio visits, grabbing morning coffee, or hauling afternoon market pickups, the canvas bag shifts from pure utility to style component without missing a beat. It’s an approach to dressing that mirrors her broader design philosophy: high-impact style doesn't require overthinking, but just takes the right piece caught in the act of living. a4977d3fa4:d3e88f0de1d0e9bd.title: Ann Demeulemeester Opens Paris Flagship Store at the Palais Royal
a4977d3fa4:d3e88f0de1d0e9bd.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:d3e88f0de1d0e9bd.summary: Summary Ann Demeulemeester has opened a 150-square-meter boutique inside Paris's Jardin du Palais Royal, its second new store of 2026 after MilanThe space houses the complete Ann Demeulemeester collection, including its Serax tableware lineFollowing this opening, London and Tokyo flagships, and a Shanghai shop-in-shop will arrive in 2027 Ann Demeulemeester has opened a new Paris boutique inside the Jardin du Palais Royal, placing its latest flagship within one of the city's most historic settings. The 150-square-meter space is the house's second retail debut this year, arriving months after its Milan store at Via Monte Napoleone 22, and it pushes forward a plan to put down permanent roots in fashion's key cities.Inside, the boutique brings every category under one roof. Menswear and womenswear share the floor with footwear, accessories and the house's tableware collection for Serax, turning the store into a single destination where each facet of the brand sits side by side. To mark the occasion, the brand has produced a limited-edition shirt that revisits one of the label's signature designs, recasting it as a collectible edition. From a design perspective, the interiors juxtapose grand scale with a sense of closeness. The nearly grayscale space houses a masterclass in minimalist design. Materials were selected for their tactile nature, and bespoke furniture and lighting complete the aesthetic. Every architectural choice is tuned to let the garments and the space converse, reinforcing the craft-first, independent spirit that Ann Demeulemeester has always protected.The opening is part of a tightly edited flagship plan that continues in 2027 with a London store, a Tokyo flagship and a shop-in-shop at Shanghai's Plaza 66.Ann Demeulemeester Paris151-154 Galerie de ValoisJardin du Palais RoyalParis, France Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:bf1c6e077d75b7c0.title: Taryn Simon’s Untold Stories of the FBI Go Up at Guggenheim
a4977d3fa4:bf1c6e077d75b7c0.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:bf1c6e077d75b7c0.summary: Summary Taryn Simon unveils her exhibition, 'Father Country I Do Love You,' at the Guggenheim Museum in New YorkThe largest body of work to debut in the museum's history, the show spans photography, video, installation, and sculpture all based off of the accounts of an unnamed ex-FBI agentSimon dedicates the show to her father, also an ex-government worker, whom the structure and closing act is based off of Taryn Simon’s new exhibition, Father Country I Do Love You, covers almost every surface of the Guggenheim’s spiraling rotunda. Her work, much of it appearing pristine, unearths messy, invisible contours of power. The over 1,000 new photographs, videos, sculptures, and text works on view can be traced back to the wild life of just one man, and, for many, you have to see it to believe it.An unnamed FBI agent guides her through the dark maze of the American government for her most ambitious show yet — and the largest body of work ever to debut at the Guggenheim. Organized by Nat Trotman and Nancy Spector, with support from Bottega Veneta, the exhibition was nearly a decade in the making. It chronicles the life of the agent, who acted as a “middleman” in most of these operations, and traces one person’s commitment to duty, to his country, and the livelihoods he’d be willing to put on the line for it.The exhibition is organized into 42 chapters, and each, ensnaring in their earthy, twee palettes, is built around a subject or side character in a story by the agent. Just beyond an opening portrait of a Quantico-trained Jodie Foster, for example, is the “pool room,” washed floor to ceiling in a serene, aquatic teal. Within them is a series of Moore family portraits, shot in the pool where Rasheeda Moore lured former D.C. mayor Marion Barry into the 1990 drug sting that led to his arrest.“Espionage home searches were rare but kind of fun,” the agent told Simon. Plinths topped with roadkill photographs trail into another mustard-yellow section. Massive glossy shots of…

a4977d3fa4:b18a7c099d00f1fe.title: WHITE Box Just Brought 50 Contemporary Brands to Milan Fashion Week
a4977d3fa4:b18a7c099d00f1fe.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:b18a7c099d00f1fe.summary: WHITE Box is the latest hub from the go-to trade exhibition WHITE Milano. Expanding on its diverse womenswear offering, the showcase brought a fresh collective of streetwear, art and tech brands to Milan Fashion Week with its debut edition.Running over four days, WHITE Box landed among a series of other new additions to WHITE Milano, including Nuvola, a fashion accessories fair, and More, a beauty and lifestyle fair. Located in the Tortona Fashion District, they came together to reaffirm the area as an important cultural destination for the fashion industry. At the WHITE Box space, an open structure allowed local fashion enthusiasts as well as buyers and journalists to freely explore new trends and unreleased products in the contemporary scene. Designers in the line-up also harnessed this dynamic setting, bringing their artistic vision to life through unique booth displays that challenged the rigid catwalk format.Within the program, wearable art brand Art Ophera led the immersive set-up with airbrush customization. Similarly, Butish, an Italian streetwear label, added crystals to its latest pieces, while creative platform WNLAB hosted workshops on sewing and tote bag painting. Outside, Lotta’s “Low Life on Wheels” truck took retail to another level with a multifunctional space featuring a rotating line-up of brands, such as Grocerybags and Papa Ghana, as well as Twitch live streams, art, and music. These booths revolved around a central site-specific installation by Milanese artist Gioele Corradengo, better known as Sexsdreams. Promoting a new collection of limited-edition bear toys, he showcased a large-scale “Crying Teddy” inflatable and also applied live artwork to attendees’ clothing so no one left empty-handed.Take a look back at the debut WHITE Box show in the gallery above. a4977d3fa4:93dac342a323c069.title: Josh Hart Doesn’t Believe in Luck, Only “I Will”
a4977d3fa4:93dac342a323c069.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:93dac342a323c069.summary: Josh Hart was the glue guy on the 2026 champion Knicks, a starting shooting guard whose rebounding, defensive versatility, and perimeter shooting held the rotation together. In the series-clinching 94-90 win that ended New York's 53-year title drought, the Maryland native put up 13 points and 11 rebounds. Ask him how it happened and he'll point to the work.Basketball takes up most of the 31-year-old's year, but his off-seasons have gradually pulled him into fashion. In the summer of 2024, David Yurman signed Hart alongside Seth Curry, Kyle Kuzma, Jaime Jaquez Jr., D'Angelo Russell, Kevin Love, and Jalen Green for the jeweler's first major partnership with NBA players. This summer, after the title run, Tommy Hilfiger welcomed him into its "Tommy Family" at a small celebration in New York City.As a kid, Hart watched the athletes he idolized star in blue-chip commercials and told himself, "I will make it happen." Years later, with ambassador roles at two major brands and a front-row seat at Hilfiger's Spring 2027 ready-to-wear show during New York Fashion Week, he's still a little stunned at how it played out: "It's crazy that everything kind of came full circle.""The root of “I Will” is about silencing the doubters." — Josh HartOff the court, Hart's style is effortless, polished, tailored streetwear, and he matches his fragrance to the season as deliberately as he does his clothes. The summer off-season calls for white tees, sneakers, and something light and floral. Once basketball season and its tunnel walks come around, he moves into peacoats, slacks, Chelsea boots, and loafers, with vanilla and amber to match. That routine took years to build. In middle school, he emptied cans of Axe like every other kid, and one of his first real fragrances was a gift from his mother, tucked inside a little cigar case. It wasn't until college that he started taking scent seriously and building a rotation so he wouldn't "just smell like outside."Hart has spent his career fielding…

a4977d3fa4:3ca5c42867c74b6a.title: Mr. Bailey Launches Terracotta Collection That's Built For The Future
a4977d3fa4:3ca5c42867c74b6a.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:3ca5c42867c74b6a.summary: After six years of exploring craft, longevity and modular construction in partnership with HLT+ and Vibram, London-based designer and founder of CONCEPT(K) Mr. Bailey has released its newest collection, Terracotta.Inspired by the fractured geometry of dried earth, Terracotta focuses on longevity by reinterpreting repairable footwear. Within the soles of each shoe lie three distinctive layers built with the purpose of renewing the components that are exposed to the most use and naturally wear down over time. Central to Mr. Bailey’s mission is extending the lifespan of every creation, making each shoe pass through generations and accumulate years of wear.Maintaining durability is integral to their design, preserving elements that give the shoes an independent uniqueness and mold with the wearer over time. Breaking down the internal design construction of the sole includes a permanent structural outsole, an EVA compression layer that provides ultimate cushioning, and a replaceable Vibram ground layer that forms the external contact surface of the shoe. Every pair is provided with an additional set of replacement Vibram ground components, alongside benefits including access to sole repair services that help the shoes perform at their optimal capacity.The first Terracotta collection includes three key silhouettes. Functional and distinctive in design, the Hiker is a mid-cut style that features Loop Back lacing that wraps around metal hardware to maintain tension around the foot when in use, inspired by early ski and Alpine footwear. The Terracotta Derby references traditional Alpine Haferlschuh through asymmetric side-lacing, while the Mule takes a very simplistic approach with a slip-on function. Each one is crafted using a leather upper as well as the highly anticipated, interchangeable sole system. Putting durability at the forefront to allow this collection to last a lifetime.Check out the shoes in the gallery above and head to Mr. Bailey's Instagram for updates.…

a4977d3fa4:137fb92626c18cda.title: Havaianas and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed Top Toe Mule

Following their initial sold-out release, the new silhouette reimagines Havaianas' signature design language through Zellerfeld's advanced 3D-printing technology.The Top Toe Mule bridges traditional sandal elements with a closed-toe aesthetic. Engineered as a single continuous piece without stitching or glue, the shoe preserves Havaianas' signature V-shaped strap and toe-post identity while adding a fully enclosed front section for increased protection and versatility. Subtle side cut-outs are incorporated into the upper, designed specifically to encourage styling alongside Havaianas' split-toe sock collection.Utilizing Zellerfeld’s 3D-printing process, the complete shape, structure, and cushioning are integrated into one continuous form. The silhouette debuts across five distinct colorways, ranging from understated neutral shades of oat, black, and stone to bright lilac and yellow options.The Havaianas x Zellerfeld Top Toe Mule launches on October 5, 2026, exclusively at Dover Street Market Paris, London, and New York stores and online. a4977d3fa4:877b9f191d0ee60f.title: Sony Releases QSSR AI Upscaling for the Base PS5, Bringing Sharper Visuals Without a Pro Upgrade
a4977d3fa4:877b9f191d0ee60f.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:877b9f191d0ee60f.summary: Summary Sony drops QSSR, bringing AI-driven upscaling directly to the base PlayStation 5 architectureThe AMD-backed tech arrives first on 'Marvel’s Wolverine' and 'Ghost of Yōtei' via October 1 patchesQSSR offers a software-level alternative to the hardware-accelerated upscaling previously locked behind the premium PS5 Pro Sony officially leveled the playing field for the base console generation with the launch of Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR). This AI graphics upscaling technology is engineered specifically for the standard PlayStation 5. The current console life cycle has been consistently held back by low resolution outputs and poor upscaling solutions because the original architecture lacks dedicated machine learning chips. Sony bridges that gap by providing a scalable software alternative to the hardware-accelerated upscaling previously locked behind the premium Pro model. Project Amethyst served as the internal banner for the breakthrough partnership with AMD.PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) remains the gold standard according to official brand statements. Because the base hardware is missing dedicated machine learning silicon, QSSR operates at a slightly slower pace than its Pro-level counterpart. Standard rigs can expect the technology to hit an upscaled 1440p resolution instead of pushing the upscaled 4K visuals seen on advanced hardware. Principal graphics R&D engineer Daniel Craig stressed that developers must stay flexible to maximize the software. Studios carefully tune their render resolutions alongside presentation targets based on the active graphics mode.Implementing the upgrade is designed to be largely frictionless for the industry despite the required tuning. Quick Spectral Super Resolution acts as a straightforward drop-in replacement for any title that already supports PSSR. Sony confirmed the toolkit will be offered broadly to all developers moving forward. The rollout officially kicked off on October 1 when Marvel’s…

a4977d3fa4:5f22dc69be3a019b.title: Technics' EAH-A1000 Is a Hi-Fi Speaker Squeezed Into a Pair of Headphones
a4977d3fa4:5f22dc69be3a019b.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:5f22dc69be3a019b.summary: Summary Technics has unveiled the EAH-A1000, a new flagship wireless over-ear built around a newly developed 40 mm Magnetic Fluid DriverSpeaker-derived tech including an SST Edge and a cone-shaped carbon fiber diaphragm targets lower distortion and a bigger soundstageA new Flow Arm design, re-engineered fit and up to 45 hours of playback round out the package in Black and a new Platinum Greige Technics has introduced the EAH-A1000, its new flagship wireless headphones, centered on a newly developed 40 mm Magnetic Fluid Driver. The over-ear model pulls acoustic engineering from the brand's speaker division into personal audio, pairing it with a next-generation Adaptive Noise Cancelling system and a newly designed Flow Arm headband.The driver is the core of the build. Bigger drivers deliver more scale, but they are also harder to keep in check, since any tilt, wobble or bending in the diaphragm translates into distortion. Technics' answer is magnetic fluid, a material that behaves as both a magnet and a liquid. Sitting between the voice coil and the driver magnet, it steadies the diaphragm's motion and dampens stray vibration. The approach isn't new to the brand, which previously used magnetic fluid tech in its in-ear models, including the EAH-TZ700 and EAH-AZ100, but this marks its jump to a full-size over-ear driver.Supporting that driver is an SST (Symmetrical Surround Technology) Edge, a component lifted from Technics' Hi-Fi flagship speakers. By making the surround's forward and backward travel more symmetrical as it holds the diaphragm, the edge cuts down on distortion. The diaphragm itself is carbon fiber, chosen for being light and stiff, and shaped as a cone to resist flexing across its larger surface. Technics labels it "Pure Carbon Fiber," a term the brand uses to describe a non-composite, non-laminated construction rather than one made solely from carbon fiber. The combined goal is fast, stable driver response that keeps bass weighty and the soundstage…

a4977d3fa4:288ddbdaf93dc14c.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:288ddbdaf93dc14c.summary: Summary A24 has turned Robert Pattinson's run of roles with the studio into a six-piece set of nesting dolls Each doll depicts a different character, spanning The Rover in 2014 through Primetime and The Drama in 2026 The set is made entirely from linden wood and stands 5.75 inches tall A24 is tracking its history with Robert Pattinson with a series of Nesting Dolls that stack six of his characters into a single linden wood set, tracing his work from 2014's The Rover to 2026's Primetime. Released as part of the studio's Primetime merchandise, the collectible turns one of modern cinema's most unpredictable filmographies into a hand-sized object you can open layer by layer.The build keeps things traditional. The set is crafted from 100% linden wood, a soft, fine-grained timber long favored for carving and for Russian matryoshka dolls in particular, and measures 5.75 inches tall. Each of the six figures represents a separate Pattinson role, so the act of unstacking the set becomes a walk through his career.The listing presents the lineup starting with Chris Hansen from Primetime (2026), suggesting he serves as the outermost doll. In the film, Pattinson plays the real-life television journalist Chris Hansen, best known for Dateline's To Catch a Predator segments. Next comes Charlie Thompson from The Drama (2026), the romantic dramedy that paired him with Zendaya.Further in, the dolls move through the run of films that reshaped Pattinson's reputation. There's Ephraim Winslow, who also goes by Thomas Howard, from The Lighthouse (2019), Robert Eggers' black-and-white fever dream opposite Willem Dafoe, and Monte from High Life (2018), Claire Denis' deep-space prison drama. Constantine "Connie" Nikas from the Safdie brothers' Good Time (2017) follows, with Reynolds "Rey" from David Michôd's The Rover (2014) at the core of the set.Taken together, the six characters map the period when Pattinson moved away from blockbuster franchise fame and toward auteur-driven, often…

a4977d3fa4:5477734011eddd0a.summary: Name: Nike Dunk Low “Shibuya Halloween”Colorway: Bog Green/Bog Green-Black-Luminous GreenSKU: IX5169-300MSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: October 2026Where to Buy: NikeThe Nike Dunk Low "Shibuya Halloween" is set to join the brand's Halloween 2026 collection, bringing its Tokyo-inspired Shibuya theme to the Dunk for the first time. Nike used the same abbreviation in 2019 across three Air Force 1 releases tied to the neighborhood, two centered on Shibuya itself and a third that also leaned into Halloween, so the insole branding gives this Dunk a direct link to that earlier run. a4977d3fa4:072cfe30e3471509.title: Moncler Grenoble Summits Switzerland’s Engadin Valley for Its Fall/Winter 2027 Reveal
a4977d3fa4:072cfe30e3471509.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:072cfe30e3471509.summary: Summary Moncler Grenoble is heading to Switzerland's Engadin Valley to present its Fall/Winter 2027 collection on February 6, 2027The show forms the centerpiece of a weekend-long celebration of mountain landscape, culture and lifestyleThe collection promises to fuse technical performance with high style, building on the label's mountain heritage Moncler Grenoble will unveil its Fall/Winter 2027 collection in Switzerland's Engadin Valley on February 6, 2027, staging the reveal at an intimate location that remains undisclosed. Rather than a conventional runway moment, the presentation will anchor a full weekend built around life in the Alps.The setting is a deliberate fit for a line built for altitude. Moncler Grenoble is the house's dedicated skiwear and mountain performance label, and its name nods to the 1968 Winter Olympics in Grenoble, where Moncler outfitted the French national ski team. The brand itself traces back to 1952, when it was founded in Monestier-de-Clermont, a mountain village outside Grenoble.The Engadin is also familiar territory. The valley is home to St. Moritz, where Moncler Grenoble has previously staged runway presentations set against snow-covered terrain. Returning to the region keeps the label's major moments rooted in the landscape its clothing is designed to handle.As for the collection itself, the brand is positioning Fall/Winter 2027 at the meeting point of high performance and high style. It describes the range as drawing on the research, ideas and passion accumulated across its history, pairing a respect for mountain heritage with a push toward what comes next in technical outerwear.The weekend format reinforces that message. By surrounding the show with the culture and lifestyle of the alpine world, Moncler Grenoble is presenting the collection as part of a broader mountain way of life rather than as product alone. Details on materials, construction and silhouettes have not yet been released, and the exact venue is being kept…

a4977d3fa4:93e01e0fa9eb72e1.title: mfpen Fall/Winter 2026 Collection Looks Like It Has Already Lived a Full Life
a4977d3fa4:93e01e0fa9eb72e1.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:93e01e0fa9eb72e1.summary: Summary mfpen's Fall/Winter 2026 collection is built around garments designed to look and feel as though they have been worn for yearsSharp tailoring is roughed up with utilitarian outerwear, washed denim, soft knits and weathered leatherThe materials lean into visible age, from pilled bouclé jersey to brushed and faded organic cotton denim mfpen has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, a co-ed offering that treats signs of wear as a design feature. The season takes familiar wardrobe staples and nudges them slightly off their usual course, so each piece reads as recognizable but quietly out of place, as if pulled from someone else's past.The fabric choices do most of the storytelling. Overcoats are cut from soft recycled wool, while the denim uses organic cotton that has been brushed and faded to suggest seasons of washing. Jersey arrives in bouclé with a deliberately pilled surface, and black leather carries scratches across its face. Rather than chasing a pristine finish, every material is treated to look handled, aged and moved in.Construction follows the same logic. Refined tailoring forms the backbone of the collection, but it is never left to stand on its own. Instead, it is paired with hardworking outerwear, washed denim, soft knitwear and worn leather, so a sharply cut piece might sit against something rugged or relaxed. The mix is intentional, making the wardrobe feel gathered piece by piece over time instead of designed as a single matched set.Texture and silhouette carry the contrast. Smooth wool meets nubby bouclé, structured shapes meet looser layers, and the scuffed leather and faded denim add grit to the cleaner tailored pieces. Each garment hints at its own backstory, while the styling lets those different histories overlap, building a sense of character through accumulation rather than polish.The approach sits squarely within the label's broader focus on reworking classic garments with relaxed proportions and a commitment to responsible…

a4977d3fa4:7db5bc509d622f53.title: Paramount Releases New 'Ebenezer' Trailer From Director Ti West

The film stars Johnny Depp as Ebenezer Scrooge, marking the actor's first major Hollywood studio release in eight years.Guided by the logline "The name you know, the story you don't," the new trailer highlights Ti West's signature horror aesthetic—best known from his X trilogy—by leaning into the darker elements of the classic holiday tale. a4977d3fa4:f235cb65bf333fb6.title: Quavo Drops 'QRÖMELIFE' Produced Entirely by Pharrell Williams
a4977d3fa4:f235cb65bf333fb6.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:f235cb65bf333fb6.summary: Summary Quavo has released his third solo studio album titled 'QRÖMELIFE' produced entirely by Pharrell WilliamsPharrell serves as the sole producer across all 14 tracks pushing Quavo into brighter more experimental stadium soundscapesThe project features an all-star guest lineup including Offset Future Tyler the Creator A$AP Rocky Lil Baby and Justin Timberlake Quavo has officially released his third solo studio album, QRÖMELIFE, executive produced entirely by Pharrell Williams. Released via Quality Control Music and Motown, the 14-track project stands as a unique outlier in Quavo's discography by relying on a single producer to shape the entire record's sonic direction. Challenged by Pharrell to branch beyond traditional trap arrangements and venture into "stadium music," Quavo utilizes the album to explore experimental sounds, club-ready house beats, and expansive melodies. The partnership spans 14 tracks crafted exclusively by Pharrell, including the lead single "HAAVIN"—which debuted on the runway at Pharrell’s Louis Vuitton Spring/Summer 2027 show in Paris—and the 1980s freestyle-interpolating track "Trance (Walk It Down)."Beyond its singular production background, QRÖMELIFE functions as a personal journey navigating grief, faith, fatherhood, and reconciliation. Nine guest artists join Quavo across seven songs, highlighted by a long-awaited reunion with Offset on "Away," marking their first joint record since 2021. Additional features include T.I., Future, Lil Baby, Yung Miami, Justin Timberlake, and a heavy-hitting posse cut titled "Baby Breath" alongside Tyler, the Creator, A$AP Rocky, and Pharrell himself.QRÖMELIFE is available now to stream on Spotify, Apple Music, and all major digital music platforms via Quality Control Music and Motown. a4977d3fa4:377ef8f84fc0968f.title: Diptyque Crowns Its Returning Citrouille Candle With a Porcelain Pumpkin Lid
a4977d3fa4:377ef8f84fc0968f.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:377ef8f84fc0968f.summary: Summary Diptyque's seasonal Citrouille (Pumpkin) Classic Candle is back for fall as a limited editionThe fragrance builds on a full pumpkin base lifted by spice and rounded out with vanillaA handcrafted biscuit porcelain lid topped with a sculpted pumpkin is offered alongside the candle to protect the wax and hold in its scent Diptyque is bringing back its Citrouille (Pumpkin) Classic Candle for Fall 2026, releasing the seasonal scent as a limited edition. This year's return pairs the candle with a dedicated biscuit porcelain lid, crowned with a decorative pumpkin and made by hand.The scent is built from the pumpkin outward. Its gourd-forward core reads full and rounded, while a layer of lively spice gives it lift and a generous vanilla adds a sweet, almost edible depth. The intended effect is cozy and upbeat rather than heavy, a candle meant to brighten a room as much as warm it. With this edition, Citrouille slots back into the Maison's broader library of botanical fragrances.The lid is the more tactile part of the release. It is crafted from biscuit porcelain, a matte, unglazed porcelain fired without a glossy finish, and finished with a pumpkin ornament on top. Each one is handcrafted, giving the accessory an objet quality that extends the candle's presence on a shelf when it isn't lit.Function sits alongside the form. Placed over the Classic Candle, the lid shields the wax from dust and helps keep the fragrance from fading between burns, so the scent stays fresher across the season. It is designed specifically for the Classic Candle format, which typically holds 190 grams of wax, and is offered as a separate piece rather than bundled in.The Citrouille (Pumpkin) Classic Candle and White Pumpkin lid are available now until November 15. a4977d3fa4:d6f36b86728654ae.title: Pas Normal Studios x PORTER Bolts Japanese Bagmaking Straight Onto the Bike
a4977d3fa4:d6f36b86728654ae.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:d6f36b86728654ae.summary: Summary PORTER and Copenhagen cycling label Pas Normal Studios have teamed up on a six-piece bag collection built around the needs of ridersThe range splits between daily carry pieces and bike-mounted bags, covering a backpack, tote, frame bag, handlebar bag, saddle bag and coin caseEvery piece ships with an original drawstring pouch carrying both brands' logos PORTER and Pas Normal Studios are releasing a collaborative bag collection on October 2, 2026, designed with cyclists squarely in mind. The six-piece lineup pairs the Japanese bagmaker's attention to craft and materials with the forward-looking design sensibility and detailing that the Copenhagen cycling brand has built its name on.The collection is structured around two kinds of riding life. On one side sit the everyday pieces: a backpack and a tote bag sized for commutes, errands and days when the bike stays parked. On the other are three pieces built to attach directly to the bicycle, each named for where it rides: a frame bag, a handlebar bag and a saddle bag. A compact coin case rounds out the set, bridging both worlds as a small-item carry that works on or off the saddle.That on-bike trio is where the partnership feels most purpose-built. Rather than treating cycling as a styling reference, the lineup addresses practical storage across the bike itself, letting riders spread their load between frame, cockpit and seat instead of relying solely on a pack. Each piece also arrives with an original drawstring pouch printed with both brands' logos, a small extra that doubles as an organizer for tools, cables or spares.The pairing draws on two distinct lineages. PORTER is the flagship line of Tokyo's Yoshida & Co., a bagmaker founded in 1935 by Kichizo Yoshida, with the PORTER label itself dating to 1962. Its reputation rests on obsessive in-house construction and durable nylon carry, most famously the TANKER series. The company marked its 90th anniversary in 2026, a milestone it celebrated with a visual book…

a4977d3fa4:82ee6503ff327ae6.title: Nike CEO Announces Supply Restrictions for Air Jordan Retro Models
a4977d3fa4:82ee6503ff327ae6.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:82ee6503ff327ae6.summary: During Nike's Q1 FY2027 earnings call on October 1, CEO Elliott Hill announced a plan to significantly reduce the supply of Retro models from the iconic Air Jordan series, the hallmark of Jordan Brand.The Air Jordan series once sparked fierce competition on every release date, with pairs trading at premium prices on the secondary market. As of 2026, however, it has become commonplace to see store shelves lined with various retro models, with some even sitting on discount racks. Addressing this decline in brand value, Hill officially acknowledged that the company had "oversupplied the market with iconic retro products" and declared a forthcoming reduction in supply.According to published data, Jordan Brand released an average of about 10 Retro models per month over the past 12 months, from October 2025 to September 2026. In February 2026 alone (the month of the NBA All-Star Game), a staggering 19 Retro models dropped in just a single month. Combined with rising retail prices, it has become nearly impossible for consumers to collect them all. As retro models flooded the market, resale values plummeted, stripping the label of its exclusivity and status as the pinnacle of basketball footwear. In fact, this strategy of reducing the supply of retro models is already underway with the brand's flagship silhouette, the Air Jordan 1 High.2021: 20 colorways of the AJ1 High Retro released annually2025: Reduced to 15 colorways annually2026: Drastically reduced further to 12 colorways annually(*Excluding archive collaborations like Union x fragment design, Swarovski, and Virgil Abloh, there are only 7 inline colorways)While Hill did not specify an exact timeline for these adjustments, the supply restriction program is expected to be fully implemented starting in 2027. Jordan Brand aims to mark the end of an era of heavily discounted sneakers, returning to its roots as an elusive, highly coveted entity. Whether this strategic shift will reignite genuine hype within the sneaker…

a4977d3fa4:31f2aced37d05b2c.title: Inside Yung Lean’s Art Exhibition
a4977d3fa4:31f2aced37d05b2c.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:31f2aced37d05b2c.summary: Summary Jonatan Leandoer Håstad, AKA Yung Lean, unveils his first major exhibition, 'Collected Works 2016-2026,' at Torsgatan 22 in Stockholm, SwedenOn through October 11, the show features a massive collection of artworks created over the last decade, many of them being shown for the first timeThe multi-hyphenate discusses his history with visual art and the parallels between his contemporary art and music practice in a recent interview with Artsy Graffiti, not music, was Jonatan Leandoer Håstad’s “first big love.” He became obsessed with it at age 11, per a recent interview with Artsy, and predating the Swedish rap phenom the world now knows as Yung Lean, was Håstad under the moniker Verp, a then-13-year-old who, long before his ties to Sad Boys or Drain Gang, rolled with Hanoi street art collective fewcrew.All these years on, Håstad’s ascent to music stardom never actually stopped him from making art. Save for a four-piece showcase at Stockholm’s Carl Kostyál in 2016 and the elusive post from the studio here and there, he’s kept his visual practice largely in the shadows. And deliberately so. Being hesitant to professionalize this facet of his artistry, he said, was his way of keeping it “pure.”But with Collected Works 2016-2026, his first major exhibition, Håstad’s finally ready to bring his art out of the dark. A hoard of paintings, collages, sculptures, drawings, dioramas, and scenic installations has hit Torsgatan 22, the former Stockholm Gasworks, many of which are shown for the first time, making for a fully immersive entry into his visual practice. Those that can’t make the trek to Sweden, worry not; you can explore (and digitally tag) the exhibition via a virtualized version.Also premiering is Slåtter, a new short film executive-produced by and starring Håstad, which can be peeped from holes in the cement wall before it. a4977d3fa4:7e0116979c6f82d6.title: A$AP Rocky's AWGE SS27 Takes Over Paris
a4977d3fa4:7e0116979c6f82d6.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:7e0116979c6f82d6.summary: Summary A$AP Rocky's AWGE debuted its Spring/Summer 2027 collection, "ANTI WAR GLOBAL ECONOMICS," during Paris Fashion Week at the Accor Arena. Tour ticket holders got access to the runway show hours before his sold-out Don't Be Dumb concert there.The collection reworks military imagery with tactical vests, trench coats, gas mask coats, marching band jackets, and leather capes, all designed for both runway and concert stage. The show blended protest and party, subverting symbols of power while reinforcing Rocky's growing creative empire across fashion, music, and design. A$AP Rocky’s AWGE returns to the runway, this time with a surprise. Leading up to his sold-out show at the Accor Arena in Paris for his Don’t Be Dumb World Tour, the multi-hyphenate artist granted ticket holders access to the runway debut of AWGE’s Spring/Summer 2027 collection during Paris Fashion Week, taking place at the same arena he moshed in just hours later. Following its founding in 2014, originally as a creative agency directed by Rocky, AWGE has transitioned into full runway fashion collections, with its official debut show, "American Sabotage," in Paris in June of 2024. Then returning in 2025 with “Obligatory Fashion” for SS26, the brand blends conceptual streetwear, anti-establishment satire, Rocky's Harlem roots, and his personal wardrobe — the new lineup is no different. Titled “ANTI WAR GLOBAL ECONOMICS”, the newest collection, built as an open-ended manifesto, included layered tactical vests and trench coats, an asymmetrical bomber jacket-inspired skirt, AWGE ammo boxes and flight caps, shiny leather belt bags, bespoke printed denim sets, and a deep red gas mask long coat. “ANTI WAR GLOBAL ECONOMICS” reworks military imagery with looks designed for both the runway and concert stage. a4977d3fa4:c1a7b0ba21f8e021.summary: Summary Louis De Guzman joins Jordan Brand’s Artist Series for Fall 2026.The Balikbayan box inspires a collection centered on family, migration and connection.Geometric Jumpman graphics and handwritten details translate De Guzman’s Filipino-American story into apparel. Chicago-based Filipino-American visual artist and designer Louis De Guzman is joining Jordan Brand’s Artist Series for Fall 2026 with an apparel collection rooted in family, migration and the Filipino tradition of the Balikbayan box.Titled around the concept “It Took This to Get Here,” the collaboration looks back to De Guzman’s childhood in the early 1990s, when he watched his parents pack boxes with photographs, Chicago Bulls T-shirts, shoes, trading cards and handwritten notes to send to relatives in the Philippines. Before video calls made long-distance communication immediate, these packages became a tangible connection between families separated by oceans — including De Guzman and his older brother, who was still living in the Philippines at the time. That personal history is translated into the collection through handwritten details inspired by names marked onto clothing tags, alongside the Jumpman reinterpreted through De Guzman’s signature geometric visual language and color palette.The capsule carries that narrative across a practical lineup of everyday apparel, including men’s and women’s tees, an oversized fleece hoodie, women’s fleece crew, fleece pants, cargo/utility pants, an anorak and a unisex cap. Prices range from $32 USD for the cap to $170 USD for the anorak, positioning each piece as part of a broader wardrobe rather than a singular commemorative item. For De Guzman, the project reflects nearly four decades of family history and the values embedded in the Balikbayan tradition - connection, generosity and carrying one’s roots forward - while extending an artistic practice that frequently brings together his family’s immigrant journey and his own experience growing up as a…

a4977d3fa4:91f1557e62bed9db.title: G-Shock Unveils the $80,000 USD MRG-D5000 Crafted Entirely in Blue Sapphire
a4977d3fa4:91f1557e62bed9db.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:91f1557e62bed9db.summary: Summary G-Shock has officially unveiled the MRG-D5000 featuring an outer case and bezel rendered entirely in synthetic blue sapphire crystalConceived by brand creator Kikuo Ibe in 2017 the shock-resistant timepiece required nearly a decade of technical developmentProduction is strictly limited to 20 pieces globally with each watch hand-assembled by a single master technician at Casio's Yamagata factory Casio G-Shock has officially revealed the G-Shock MRG-D5000 Blue Sapphire, marking the most expensive production watch in the brand's history. Priced at $80,000 USD (£67,000 GBP), the record-setting model turns a long-standing concept envisioned by brand creator Kikuo Ibe in 2017 into an ultra-exclusive reality.Constructed entirely from lab-grown blue sapphire crystal across its outer case and bezel, the G-Shock MRG-D5000 measures 16.45mm in thickness to accommodate the material's structural requirements. To prevent fracturing without relying on traditional drill holes or screws, G-Shock engineered an interlocking assembly framework inspired by traditional Japanese timber joinery. Each sapphire element interlocks like a three-dimensional puzzle to absorb and disperse impact forces while maintaining 200-meter water resistance and solar-powered functionality.The design stays faithful to the original 1983 square silhouette, featuring a blue vapor-deposition brick-pattern face detailed with 24-carat gold lettering. Flipping the watch over reveals a Grade 5 titanium caseback set with sapphire crystal, engraved with "DREAM PROJECT" alongside its individual edition number from 1/20 to 20/20. Every timepiece in the 20-piece release is hand-assembled by a single senior technician at Casio's Yamagata facility.The G-Shock MRG-D5000 Blue Sapphire is available in an ultra-limited production run of 20 pieces globally via G-Shock. a4977d3fa4:e64ed80ccbc69966.title: Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger Cleared to Close Following $111 Billion USD Settlement Approval
a4977d3fa4:e64ed80ccbc69966.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:e64ed80ccbc69966.summary: Summary Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery are set to officially close their $111 billion USD merger on October 6, 2026US District Judge Araceli Martínez Olguín approved a settlement with 12 state attorneys general removing the final legal barrierFormer Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz will join David Ellison as co-CEO to lead the combined entertainment conglomerate Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery are scheduled to officially complete their $111 billion USD merger on October 6, 2026. U.S. District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín signed off on a settlement agreement with 12 state attorneys general, eliminating the final legal hurdle blocking the largest corporate takeover in Hollywood history.The approved consent decree establishes specific operational parameters for the combined media empire rather than requiring asset divestitures. Key terms mandate that the merged entity cannot sell the historic Paramount Studios or Warner Bros. studio lots for at least five years, must commit an additional $300 million USD annually toward U.S. film production, and must release at least 30 feature films in theaters across the first two years. Furthermore, a dedicated news editorial independence board will be established to govern journalistic principles for both CBS News and CNN.Alongside the legal resolution, the executive structure of the combined conglomerate has been formalized. Paramount chief David Ellison has brought on former Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz to serve as co-CEO, while HBO head Casey Bloys is expected to assume control of the unified streaming division. Outgoing Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav will step down as the merger officially closes.The transaction between Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery is set to close on October 6, 2026. a4977d3fa4:eb17a8d83331536c.summary: Summary BLACKPINK's LISA stars in the official global campaign for the relaunched Nike Moon ShoeOriginally prototyped in 1971 by Bill Bowerman the archival runner features its iconic waffle soleThe historic silhouette officially returns to orbit on October 1 accompanied by red color-blocked styling Nike and BLACKPINK's LISA have officially joined forces to relaunch the historic Nike Moon Shoe. The superstar brings one of the brand's oldest archival runners back into orbit, bridging the gap between 1971 track heritage and modern lifestyle appeal.First prototyped in 1971 for speed on the track, the Moon Shoe represents a foundational piece of Nike's performance history. The silhouette is defined by its signature waffle sole, a groundbreaking traction design that stems from co-founder Bill Bowerman’s earliest footwear experiments. a4977d3fa4:734a2ae688099a6d.title: Sotheby's Unveils $450 Million USD Collection Led by Rare Van Gogh, Cézanne, and Monet Works
a4977d3fa4:734a2ae688099a6d.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:734a2ae688099a6d.summary: Summary Sotheby's will offer the 12-piece Blaquier-Arrieta Collection in New York with an estimate in the region of $450 million USDThe historic offering features rare works by Vincent van Gogh Paul Cézanne and Claude Monet unseen publicly for over 50 yearsVan Gogh's Châtaigniers en fleurs and Cézanne's Arlequin are both poised to set new global auction records for the artists Sotheby's has officially unveiled The Blaquier-Arrieta Collection, an extraordinary 12-piece group of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterworks estimated to realize in the region of $450 million USD. Unseen in public for over half a century, the historic assemblage is headlined by landmark paintings from Vincent van Gogh, Paul Cézanne, and Claude Monet.Leading the offering is Van Gogh's Châtaigniers en fleurs (Chestnut Trees in Blossom), painted in May 1890 during his final months in Auvers-sur-Oise and estimated in the region of $180 million USD. The canvas depicts a blossoming chestnut canopy and a solitary figure alongside women in Japanese attire, representing one of only eight Auvers landscapes remaining in private hands.Alongside Van Gogh's work is Cézanne's 1888–1890 oil painting Arlequin, estimated in the region of $120 million USD. Depicting the artist's 17-year-old son Paul in red and black diamond checks, it stands as the only composition from Cézanne's seminal four-part Harlequin series held outside of a museum collection. Both works are positioned to set new global auction records for the respective artists.The collection also features Claude Monet’s 1876 landscape Le Jardin des Tuileries, estimated between $15 million and $20 million USD. Painted from a fifth-floor apartment on the Rue de Rivoli, it is one of only two Paris cityscapes from the series remaining in private hands. d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.title: The Scramble for the Open Seas
d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.author: Michael Albertus
d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.summary: Over the last half millennium, societies around the globe competed to divide up the world’s land. Nearly every square inch of soil outside Antarctica is now owned and tucked within national borders. But the oceans have largely been spared that fate. There were times throughout history when countries tried to gate and regulate the seas, but they were too vast to be controlled for long periods. During the Cold War, as technology made it far easier to imagine partitioning the world’s waterways and seabeds, great powers avoided an unrestrained race to grab the oceans. Most governments agreed to deal with them through a patchwork of treaties and multilateral bodies that sought to guarantee freedom of navigation in international waters and assign coastal seabeds to adjacent littoral states.

d006da4fe3:a574167532370f34.title: The Trouble With the Nuclear-AI Analogy
d006da4fe3:a574167532370f34.author: Christopher LaRoche, Ankit Panda
d006da4fe3:a574167532370f34.summary: In humanity’s quest to constrain the dangers from fast-advancing artificial intelligence, many have looked to the most revolutionary technology that preceded it: nuclear weapons. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has called artificial intelligence “far more dangerous than nukes.” Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who assigns The Making of the Atomic Bomb to employees and has likened himself to the Manhattan Project scientist Leo Szilard, describes the most powerful AI models as “weaponizable nuclear materials.” When asked how a technology such as AI can be regulated, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman often references the world’s nuclear materials watchdog, the International Atomic Energy Agency. Even the director of the CIA, John Ratcliffe, has made the same comparison.These comparisons capture real parallels. Like nuclear weapons, frontier AI is powerful and hard to control. Like nuclear technology, it can be used for good or for ill. And like the Cold War arms race, the race for AI breakthroughs may reorder the global balance of power. The nuclear analogy, then, seems to offer a blueprint for how to effectively govern a promising but potentially dangerous technology such as AI.

fc066e842d:49934de94c848c00.title: Relative Development and the Intelligence Divide: Human Capital, Technology Diffusion, and AI
fc066e842d:49934de94c848c00.author: Jonathan R. W. Temple
fc066e842d:49934de94c848c00.summary: Will artificial intelligence (AI) help poorer countries catch up? This paper argues that the answer depends less on access to AI than on the capacity to use new knowledge productively. We show that countries have narrowed gaps in capital and schooling more readily than gaps in productivity. Technology can diffuse widely without producing productivity convergence. Measured human capital explains only a modest share of productivity differences in levels, but is associated with sharply different mobility regimes. The estimated transition processes imply an expected time to exit the lowest-productivity state of about 65 years for economies below the estimated human-capital threshold, compared with about 25 years for those above it. This reconciles development accounting with the view of human capital as absorptive capacity. If AI mainly augments skilled workers and capable firms, it may reinforce existing gaps. If it lowers the costs of learning, adaptation, and implementation in weaker-capability economies, it could instead promote convergence. The Intelligence Divide is therefore not simply about access to AI, but about the capacity to turn knowledge into productivity.

fc066e842d:e0411ad22edea77d.title: Growth in Chains: EU Value Chain Productivity and its Slowdown
fc066e842d:e0411ad22edea77d.author: Lähdemäki, Sakari
fc066e842d:e0411ad22edea77d.summary: Abstract We study Europe’s post-2008 productivity slowdown using novel total factor productivity (TFP) measures that follow production beyond individual industries in global value chains (GVCs). We collect a newset of stylized facts: (1) the slowdown is broad-based, with productivity growth weakening both in final-producer industries and in upstream industries; (2) the staggered entry into force of bilateral investment treaties with China is followed by higher value-chain TFP and greater business-intangible investment; while (3) the gains associated with technology intangibles are weak. We use these facts to discipline a stylized two-region general-equilibrium model with business capabilities, technology-related knowledge, and cross-border knowledge spillovers. The calibration supports a two-stage interpretation of Europe’s experience: (1) sizeable initial integration gains because accumulated business capabilities convert market access into productivity, and (2) later losses when technology improvements are converted into productivity more effectively elsewhere.

fc066e842d:b24979dbe73586d0.title: What Does Venture Capital Actually Finance ? Scale and Structure around the World
fc066e842d:b24979dbe73586d0.author: Mauro, Paolo
fc066e842d:b24979dbe73586d0.summary: Venture capital is widely viewed as financing knowledge-intensive, R&D-driven startups, but owing to data constraints, this view has been based largely on high-income economies. By taking a global perspective, this paper documents that what venture capital finances differs systematically across economies, varying with institutional and business conditions rather than following a single model. Using a new cross-country dataset that harmonizes firm-level venture capital records with equity issuance data for more than 150 economies, the data shows that VC markets differ across countries not only in scale but in kind. Outside high-income countries, rather than being concentrated in knowledge intangibles, venture capital tilts–at both the sector and firm levels–toward organizational intangibles such as distribution, logistics, and payments. Highlighting the unique features of venture capital, this pattern is absent from public equity markets, where sectoral composition is far more similar across income levels. An accounting decomposition separates venture capital depth into the rate at which firms enter the market and the funding each entrant attracts, and entry accounts for the largest cross-country gaps. Moreover, the business environment is associated with VC primarily through entry, linked both to the size of the market and to the composition of what venture capital finances, the latter through entry into knowledge-intensive sectors in particular.

fc066e842d:81f95d80d259f0cf.title: Black Feminist Social Work: Centering Black Women's Knowledge in Social Work Theory, Education, Research, Policy, and Practice
fc066e842d:81f95d80d259f0cf.author: Talley, Vanessa M.
fc066e842d:81f95d80d259f0cf.summary: Social work acknowledges Black Feminist Thought as a framework and praxis, yet the profession has not established a social work framework that explicitly centers Black women’s epistemologies as foundational to education, theory, research, policy, and practice. Although social work maintains a historical commitment to social justice, person-in-environment, and human rights perspectives, dominant theories and knowledge systems continue to reflect Eurocentric assumptions regarding knowledge production and professional expertise. This article introduces Black Feminist Social Work (BFSW) as a conceptual framework that centers Black women’s individual and collective lived experiences, intellectual traditions, historical resistance, and knowledge to inform social work theory, education, research, policy, and practice. Drawing upon Black feminism, Black Feminist Thought, Womanism, Intersectionality, and the profession’s ethical commitments, the BFSW framework proposes a necessary shift from positioning Black women primarily as a population to be studied to recognizing them as producers of transformative knowledge. This article introduces four organizing principles, the Four C’s: Centering, Contextualizing, Co-Creating, and Changing, as foundational processes for Black Feminist Social Work and discusses the implications for curriculum development, clinical practice, research methodologies, policy advocacy, and future scholarship. Rather than positioning Black Feminist Social Work as an alternative specialization, this framework argues that centering Black women’s knowledge expands the social work profession’s capacity to pursue equity, liberation, and social transformation.

fc066e842d:1ada7049cb8f2e03.title: Standardizing Business Process Documentation for Operational Transition: A Case Study of Employee Administration Data Entry at PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Persero) Tbk
fc066e842d:1ada7049cb8f2e03.author: Athira, Celia
fc066e842d:1ada7049cb8f2e03.summary: Organizational transitions that transfer operational activities from internal units to external partners depend heavily on the availability of standardized process documentation. This study examines the business process of Employee Administration (EA) Kedinasan data entry within the Employee & Organization Data Operation (EODO) unit of PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, undertaken as part of the company's preparation to transfer data-entry activities to an external partner, PT Infomedia Nusantara. Using a descriptive-qualitative case study approach grounded in Business Process Management (BPM) theory, the study maps the existing (as-is) process through direct observation, documentation review, and discussion with field supervisors, and evaluates it using SWOT analysis to identify internal and external factors shaping the transition. The findings show that although the EA Kedinasan process already possesses a structured workflow supported by verification and approval checkpoints and a centralized SAP-based system, its documentation remains fragmented across multiple work instructions and lacks an integrated reference that can function effectively as a knowledge-transfer medium for an external partner. The study recommends the consolidation of Business Process diagrams, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, and a Playbook into a single coherent documentation package, which was implemented in part during the internship. Beyond its immediate organizational relevance, the case illustrates a broader tension in business process transitions: technically sound processes can still generate transition risk when explicit-knowledge artifacts are not consolidated for an external audience. The study contributes a practitioner-grounded account of how BPM and knowledge-transfer principles operate in a real outsourcing transition within a large Indonesian state-owned enterprise, and offers implications for organizations preparing similar administrative…
